mensagens.input: Katie and Franklin each brought a piece of cheese to the school picnic. Katie and Franklin brought different types of cheese so it looks like they brought the same amount, but not necessarily the same weight. Katie claims that her cheese is heavier. Is this true?
Katie's cheese weighs 2/5 of a pound.
Franklin's cheese weighs 2/3 of a pound.
-----,Yes; the piece of cheese Katie brought is heavier.,No. Katie is not right. The piece of cheese Franklin brought is heavier.,Both pieces of cheese weigh the same.
